fomod.Name: N.D.A. (NPCs Die in Anomalies) - Priler
fomod.Author: Priler (based on the original idea/mod by AllC0r3)
fomod.Description: NPCs and stalkers detect, avoid, and can die to anomalies. Adds anomaly-aware pathfinding restrictions, damage when caught inside a field, corpse-loot and heal guards, and full MCM tuning (detection, avoidance, damage, kill-rate caps per faction and rank). For Anomaly 1.5.3 and GAMMA.
